vehicles.name: Heatherbell S 1987
vehicles.referenceVehicle: 1987 European Porsche 959 S production road coupe, 515 PS variant, six-speed manual AWD; not standard Komfort 450 PS or Dakar/961
limits: Generic historical 959 slot resolved to the well-documented S variant. Does not count Komfort separately. Factory table explicitly supplies S geometry and DIN curb mass; PS is retained separately from kW-converted mechanical hp.
Ratios are estimates; six forward ratios approximate the original G plus five-road-gear arrangement. Fixed AWD balance and conventional dampers do not reproduce Porsche active programs.

Every simulation input not in facts is an explicitly provisional modeling estimate, including ratios, torque curve away from anchors, mechanical loss, load/inertia, springs/dampers, tire grip, steering, aero and performance. No OEM active-control fidelity claimed.
RTG-001 graphics/cockpit are shared by reference; no original model-specific artwork or browser driving certification.

Factory 561 Nm at 6500 rpm mathematically implies about 382 kW, slightly above its separately published 379 kW. The estimated curve is capped at the 379 kW anchor; nominal peak torque remains in provenance, and this is not an exact reproduction of both rounded source peaks.
